programme.desc: Cisco and Pancho aid a poor man who gets caught up in a cattle rustling operation. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951. This episode aired in 1951.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco heads to the town of Twin Buttes and finds a haven for criminals. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951 . This episode aired in 1951.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detectives Matt and Frankie work to save a young man from a hangman's noose in New Mexico.Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle, along with Miachael Hall, Mitchell Kowall, and Jean Inness. Directed by William Witney. Episode first aired in 1954.Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White.Series won an Emmy in 1955. (This episode features the beloved character actor Jack Elam as Black Jack Ketchum.)

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Matt and Frankie investigate a cattle dispute in Wyoming. When evidence starts to add up, it leads them to Matt's old friend Tom Horn.Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Also sarring Louis Jean Heydt, Harry Woods, Michael Whalen, Stanley Andrews, and Walter Coy. Directed by William Witney. Produced by B movie veteran Edward White. Episode first aired in 1954.Series won an Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detective Matt Clark goes undercover working at a gambling den. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Directed by William Witney. Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White. Episode first aired in 1954.Series won an Emmy in 1955. Also starring Dick SImmons, Claire Carleton, Mauritz Hugo, Howard Wright, and Douglas Evans.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detective Frankie is shot during a robbery. Her life becomes in danger when her doctor is kidnapped by the murderous outlaw Clay Allison.Starring Jim Davis, Mary Castle, Jack Kelly, Paul Farber, Frank Fenton, and Fred Sherman.Directed by William Witney. Episode first aired in 1954. Produced by B movie veteran Edward White. Series won an Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Hawkeye and Chingachcook suspect that a young man's uncle is behind the recent attacks against him. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper.Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: A man asserts that he has a Royal Grant that gives him ownership of the entire town.Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in November, 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: A town turns against Eben Cotten as he is accused of selling rifles to the Indians. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in December, 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: An editor of a newspaper is framed for murder. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in December, 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: A doll seems to cast a spell on Little Snowbird (Rochelle Goldstein). Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in December, 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Since the arrival of a Lt. Smith, members of the Iroquois tribe keep turning up dead. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper.Episode originally aired December 25, 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Hawkeye learns that his brother has joined the British army and is now a redcoat. However, when he is murdered by a treacherous Indian companion, Hawkeye seeks revenge. Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: The Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Hawkeye and Chingachcook come across a group of settlers trapped in the Huron's territory.Hawkeye: John Hart. Chingachcook: Lon Chaney Jr. This syndicated series was filmed in Toronto, and was the final project of prolific Hollywood director Sam Newfeild. Based on characters created by James Fenimore Cooper. Episode originally aired in 1957.

programme.title: Bells of San Angelo
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Dale Evans team up in this tale of silver mines, kidnappings, and secret passages. Roy plays a border guard who has to rescue Dale from the clutches of underhanded miner Rex Gridley (John McGuire). How does he do it? With help from Trigger, of course! With a cast that inclues Andy Devine as Sheriff Cookie Bullfincer, director William Witney gives us an enjoyable drama from the golden era of Republic Pictures!

programme.title: Home in Oklahoma
programme.desc: The entire gang is here! Roy Rogers, Dale Evans, Gabby Hayes, and Trigger are all involved in a murder mystery involving the death of a wealthy ranch owner. Songs include I Wish I Was A Kid Again and Cowboy Ham and Eggs.

programme.title: Way of the West
programme.desc: Government agent Gordon (Hal Taliaferro) goes undercover to investigate an ongoing war between cattlemen and sheepmen. But he soon finds himself framed for murder! This low budget western from the short-lived Empire Pictures is from the golden era of shoot em ups, when audiences knew who the bad guys were, and couldnt wait for the good guys to serve up some just punishment!

programme.title: Mohawk
programme.desc: Kurt Neumann (The Fly, Rocketship X-M) directed this bawdy tale of a love that was louder than war drums! With a cast that includes Scott Brady, Rita Gam, and Neville Brand, the story takes place on a remote army post where an artist romances a trio of women, just as a vengeful settler turns the army and the local Iroquois tribe against each other. Film buffs might like to know that the cinematography for this feature is by four-time Oscar nominee Karl Struss, who won an Academy Award in 1929 for his work on Sunrise.

programme.title: McLintock
programme.desc: He likes his whiskey hard... His women soft... And his west all to himself! Inspired by Shakespeares The Taming of the Shrew (1594), John Wayne (The Searchers, Stagecoach), Maureen OHara (Miracle on 34th Street, The Parent Trap), and Patrick Wayne (The Searchers, The Alamo) star in this western comedy directed by Andrew V. McLaglen (Gunsmoke, The Wild Geese). George Washington McLintock (John Wayne) is the wealthiest man in his territory who utilizes his power and influence to maintain order between farmers, ranchers, Indians, corrupt government officials, and his own family! McLintock is McNificent!

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: The sons of a Colorado cattle baron, one biological and the other adopted, resent one another and fight for control of their father's cattle empire.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers appeared in several Republic Pictures during the 1930s, and this is considered one of their best. It's about a mysterious murder at an archeological expedition, which leads the three prairie pals into some dangerous territory. Can they solve the murder without losing their own lives? The cast includes Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune, and Roger Williams, all trying to survive a hail of poison arrows and hot lead!

programme.title: Idaho
programme.desc: Western icon Roy Rogers, along with his trusty companion Trigger, are back for another adventure. This time, a respected judge is being framed for murder by a crooked saloon owner. Always the valiant champion, Rogers vows to clear the name of the judge and find the truth all while courting a lovely beau. Cellist turned editor turned Republic Pictures workhorse Joseph Kane takes the reins of this rousing, musical adventure, which features a number of original songs performed by Rogers himself, with the help of singer-songwriter Bob Nolan and character actor Smiley Burnette (TVs Petticoat Junction).

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Tom Tyler plays Tom Wade, a range detective whose brother has been accused of robbery and murder. Wade has only one clue to prove his brothers innocence: a set of unusual tire tracks. This film was directed by Sam Katzman, who later became known as Jungle Sam for his association with a variety of jungle thrillers, and then as a master of all exploitation genres, from teen horror to flying saucer flicks!

programme.title: The Fighting Redhead
programme.desc: When a rustler named Faro kills one of his own henchmen and blames it on Sheila O'Conner, Red and Little Beaver set out to clear Sheila and to find evidence against Faro and his gang.

programme.title: Rawhide Rangers
programme.desc: Blackie's gang is creating havoc and the Ranger, Brand Calhoun and his brother go to investigate.

programme.title: Springtime in the Sierras
programme.desc: Ads for this Roy Rogers classic roared HEAD FOR THE MUSICAL HILLS...ROY IS GUNNIN' FOR THRILLS! And thrills are what you'll get when you watch this fun, action packed B-Western from Republic Pictures. There's some great comic relief from Andy Devine and Chester Conklin, two of Hollywood's all-time greats. This old-fashioned shoot-'em-up was directed by William Witney, who would go on to direct many of television's top western sagas, including Bonanza, Wagon Train, and The Wild, Wild West.

programme.title: My Pal Trigger
programme.desc: Roy Rogers goes to jail after hes wrongly accused of killing Gabby Hayes horse in this action packed yarn from Republic Pictures. All of the old jokes about cowboys kissing their horse may have started with this very movie, as it focuses on Roys loving relationship with Trigger, the greatest horse in all of Hollywood. The film also features Roys beloved Dale Evans, plus, adding some country swing to the musical numbers is Roys favorite backing band, the Sons of the Pioneers! Songs include Ole Faithful, Long, Long Ago and Livin Western Style.

programme.title: Boots and Saddles
programme.desc: When a young Englishman inherits a ranch, none other than Gene Autry takes up the challenge of turning the Brit into a real westerner. He convinces the Brit to use the ranch to raise horses, but things quickly grow complicated. Look for the usual cast of characters from Republic Pictures, including Smiley Burnette (as the irresistible Frog Millhouse!). Songs include Take Me Back To My Boots and Saddle, and Ridin the Range.

programme.title: Arizona Bound
programme.desc: The Rough Riders are called upon to help save a stagecoach line. From 1941, starring Buck Jones and Tim McCoy, plus Horace Murphy and Luana Walters. Directed by Spencer Bennett.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Story of a Horse
programme.desc: Fanning (John Miljan) has his men rustle horses and then blame it on a wild horse named Wildfire. Happy and Alkali arrive and immediately get into trouble with Fanning and his men. When Alkali is shot, Happy catches the outlaws but the Judge not only releases them, he discharges the Sheriff and tries to arrest Happy for rustling! Starring Bob Steele and Sterling Holloway, directed by Robert Emmett Tansey. 1945 (Color).

programme.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
programme.desc: Roy Rogers finds himself elected sheriff in a wild Texas town after the Civil War. But can Roy handle a place under martial law? And can he save Gabby Hayes from being executed? And how many songs will he get to sing? Clear the burrs from your saddle and get ready for a good one, also starring Marjorie Reynolds, plus Sally Payne as Belle Starr, Queen of the Oklahoma Outlaws!

programme.title: The Hanged Man
programme.desc: After a condemned gunfighter (Steve Forrest) survives his own hanging, he helps a young widow stop a pitiless land baron from taking her ranch. This television feature boasts a strong cast of recognizable characters, including Will Geer, Sharon Acker, Dean Jagger, BarBara Luna, and Cameron Mitchell. Director Michael Caffey would go on to work on such hit shows as Barnaby Jones and MacGyver. Also, look for John Mitchum, younger brother of Robert, in a small role. This movie originally aired on ABC-TV and was considered the pilot for a possible series. Writer/producer Andrew Fenady was behind several opular TV shows such as Branded and The Rebel, as well as the 1970 John Wayne feature, Chisum.

programme.title: Tulsa
programme.desc: Susan Hayward stars in this dramatic tale of the Oklahoma oil boom. She plays Cherokee Lansing, a determined young woman out to protect her father's honor after he's killed by men from a competing oil company. With a cast that includes Robert Preston, Ed Begley, and Pedro Armendariz, this engaging picture from producer Walter Wanger (Cleopatra, I Want to Live!) was nominated for an Academy Award in the Special Effects category. Also, listen for veteran character actor Chill Wills as the narrator!

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Roy Rogers's beloved horse Trigger is stolen and held for ransom money. Will Roy find $100,000 to get his faithful companion back, or will he find a way to trap the gang holding the horse hostage? Along with Roy and Trigger, you'll find Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher, and young Michael Chapin as Ted Carver, a gallant boy who helps reunite Roy with the smartest horse in show business!

programme.title: Cowboy And The Prizefighter
programme.desc: Red Ryder takes Steve Stevenson, who has saved his life, to his ranch and gives him a job. Red's aunt, the Duchess, knew Steve's father, who supposedly committed suicide after losing his ranch betting on a prizefight. Steve refuses to believe that his father took his own life, suspecting he was murdered. Red and Little Beaver aid Steve in finding his father killer.

programme.title: Hell Town
programme.desc: In Hell Town (aka Born to the West) John Wayne is back in the saddle as two-fisted Dare Rudd, a roaming cowhand trying to prove he can win a woman's love and outwit a crooked saloon owner. This exciting B-movie from Paramount Pictures was based on a novel by western writer Zane Grey. With a wild and wooly cast that includes Johnny Mack Brown, Marsha Hunt, Monte Blue, and Lucian Littlefield, director Charles Barton (Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein) gives us a tale of romance, action, and high stakes gambling!

programme.title: In Old Colorado
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy and his crew get involved in a war over water rights in this feature from Harry Sherman Productions and Paramount Pictures. The intrigue starts when crafty Joe Weller (Morris Ankrum) turns two ranchers against each other, which leads to dire results. This is the 33rd of 66 Hopalong Cassidy movies, with WIlliam Boyd in the role he made famous. Also, look for regular Hoppy co-stars Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Andy Clyde as California Carson.

programme.title: Hoppy Serves a Writ
programme.desc: Sheriff Hopalong Cassidy triumphs again in this lighthearted western romp from Harry Sherman Productions. Good ol' Hoppy (William Boyd) has to leave his beloved Texas to track down some bad guys in Oklahoma. You can bet that the action and suspense will follow Hopalong wherever he goes. Also, look for a number of familiar faces in the ast, including TV's future Superman George Reeves, notorious Hollywood heavy Victor Jory, and in his first credited role, Robert Mitchum! In fact, Mitchum would appear in more of Hoppy's adventures before branching out on his own and becoming one of Hollywood's greatest stars. Also featuring Jan Christy, Forbes Murray, Byron Foulger, Earle Hodgins, and Roy Barcroft. Directed by Goerge Archainbaud.

programme.title: The Light of Western Stars
programme.desc: Knights of the sage-brush roar across the plains in this western drama from Harry Sherman Productions. Victor Jory ( Papillon, Gone With The Wind), stars as a ranch foreman wrongly arrested for murder. The memorable cast includes Tom Tyler (Stage Coach, Adventures of Captain Marvel), plus Noah Beery Jr (The Rockford Files) and in one of his earliest feature roles, Alan Ladd (The Blue Dahlia, Shane).

programme.title: Riders of the Deadline
programme.desc: The 50th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy films finds Hoppy in a vengeful mood. When his good friend Tim Mason is unjustly sent to jail and then killed when trying to escape, Hoppys bitterness gets him drummed out of the Texas Rangers. With the help of his pals California Carson and Jimmy Rogers, he sets out to expose the real culprits and clear Tims name. The usual cast is here, including William Boyd as Hoppy, plus Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers, and in one of his earliest roles, Robert Mitchum.

programme.title: High Lonesome
programme.desc: A young drifter is suspected of murder in this stirring production from writer/director Alan Le May (best known for writing The Searchers). John Drew Barrymore stars as Cooncat, a troubled young man who has to steal to survive. With no friends in West Texas, he falls in with some bad customers who involve him in some terrible crimes. The strong cast includes Chill Wills, Jack Elam, and John Archer, with cinematography by Oscar winner W. Howard Greene.

programme.title: Born to Battle
programme.desc: Cyclone Tom Saunders starts a ruckus in a Chinese laundry and has to go before a judge. Unable to pay his fine, he is bailed out by a local cattle rancher and agrees to do 30 days' work for him. It's not too long before he becomes enmeshed in a war between rustlers and outlaws.

programme.title: The Gunman from Bodie
programme.desc: The Rough Riders, a popular group that thrilled audiences in the early 1940s, are after a gang of rustlers in this B-western from Hollywood's Poverty Row. Starring Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, and Raymond Hatton, this movie features everything from lawmen going undercover to the Rough Riders looking after an orphaned baby! Also, be on the lookout for the beautiful Christine McIntyre, who would go on to appear in several of the Three Stooges shorts for Colombia Pictures.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Ranch
programme.desc: Flagg is relocating flood victims to Gunsmoke Ranch. The Three Mesquiteers know Flagg to be a crook and try to warn them. They ignore the warning and improve the land only to find that it has been condemned for a new dam.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: A cavalry officer sympathetic to the wronged Sioux tribe fixes a meeting between Chief Sitting Bull and President Grant but a dishonest Indian Agent and a hateful General Custer test the Sioux's patience, threatening to derail the peace-talks. Directed and co-written by Sidney Salkow; starring Dale Robertson, Mary Murphy, J. Carrol Naish. Also, look for legendary character actor Iron Eyes Cody as Crazy Horse.

programme.title: Song of Arizona
programme.desc: This Roy Rogers adventure finds Gabby Whitaker (Gabby Hayes) running a ranch for wayward boys. One of the boys uses stolen money to help Gabby pay off his debts, but things unravel when the boys father, a notorious outlaw named King Blaine, is murdered; the rest of the Blaine gang show up at Gabbys looking for the loot! Director Frank McDonald works with a fine cast, including Dale Evans, Lyle Talbot, and of course, Roys beloved horse Trigger.

programme.title: Hands Across The Border
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures western about horse breeders vying for a contract with the U.S. Army. The cast also includes such favorites as Onslow Stevens and Guinn Big Boy Williams, while songs include Hey Hey (It's a Great Day), Dreaming to Music, and The Girl with the High Button Shoes. For movie buffs: The music for the title song, Hands Across the Border, was composed by none other than Hoagy Carmichael!

programme.title: Public Cowboy No. 1
programme.desc: Gene Autry and Smiley Burnette are back, and this time theyre dealing with some very modern thinking rustlers. These new criminals have taken up the latest technologies to outsmart the authorities, including shortwave radios and airplanes! Can Gene and Smiley get em? You bet! Songs include The West Aint What It Used To Be, I Got the HeebieJeebie Blues, and The Defective Detective from Brooklyn. Gene also gets romantic when he sings, I Picked up the Trail when I Found You...

programme.title: Under Western Stars
programme.desc: Roy Rogers debuts in his starring role as the likable cowboy sent to Congress with a mission: let Washington know about the suffering of farmers in the wake of America's 1930s Dustbowl. Enjoy the singing cowboy in his first starring role, rubbing shoulder with politians, going up against greedy executives, and representing a whole people group you'll see why Rogers became a national icon! Frog Millhouse: Smiley Burnett. Elanore Fairbanks: Carol Hughes. John Fairbanks: Guy Usher. Plus music and singing from the Maple City Four. (The song Dust was nominated for an Academy Award!) Directed by Joe Kane.

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures feature about the hunt for silver in a deserted ghost town. Songs include 'Colorado Joe' and 'Everything's Going My Way'. Plus, look for Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher. Film buffs should look for silent screen foil James Finlayson, a familiar face from various Keystone Cop comedies, as the local sheriff.

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Theres trouble out west! Its the Civil War and the Union needs troops back east to defend itself. Roy Rogers stars as Lieutenant Jerry Burke, who is sent to investigate why the returning troops are being stalled in Colorado. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Pauline Moore, and Milburn Stone, this film is action packed with a turn you wont see coming!

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trailblazer
programme.desc: Daniel Boone (Bruce Bennett) battles Shawnee warriors as he leads a band of settlers into Kentucky in this frontier potboiler from Albert C. Gannaway Productions. Made at the height of Hollywood's fascination with pioneer days, the film also stars Lon Chaney Jr. as Chief Blackfish, and country singer Faron Young as a handsome young suitor for Boone's daughter. There's plenty of action and danger here as the Shawnee are convinced that Boone is trying to steal their land. But Boone is ready, not even fearing death by tomahawk. It isn't how you die, Boone says. It's what you live for.

programme.title: Rawhide
programme.desc: Baseball superstar Gehrig is one of several ranchers being coerced by a bunch of bandits. His sister and her lawyer/lover organize the ranchers. Directed by Ray Taylor; starring Smith Ballew, Gehrig, Evelyn Knapp. Talk about stunt casting! Gehrig was a New York Yankees star who was nearing the end of his career, but one of the biggest sports stars in the country. In the movie he plays a variation of himself, as Lou Gehrig, a retired baseball player who takes up ranching. Lou expects to relax on his ranch but quickly joins other ranchers in a fight to protect their properties.

programme.title: Yellowneck
programme.desc: Location shooting in the Florida Everglades add to this dramatic tale of five Confederate deserters trying to get to Cuba. First, they must overcome snake bites, unfriendly Seminoles, and their own conflicts with each other. How many of the five will actually make it out alive? Lin McCarthy, Stephen Courtleigh, and Berry Kroeger star in this little known example of 1950s independent filmmaking.

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this vintage western. He and George Gabby Hayes strike it rich with a gold mine, only to find their lives complicated by women and crooked officials. Things get even messier when the good guys are framed for murder! Its all action here, particularly since legendary stuntman Yakima Cannut stars as one of the films heavies. Who will win the fight over the gold and the girl? Directed by Robert N. Bradbury for Monogram Pictures. Also starring Barbara Sheldon. (The film was also known as Gold Strike River.)

programme.title: Wagon Trail
programme.desc: The son of Sheriff Clay Hartley, of the frontier town Elder, has gotten into bad company and hangs out with an outlaw gang in which, Collins, owner of the Golden Rule Saloon, is the secret head. Sheriff Hartley suspects him, but has been unable to gather the needed evidence. Collins instructs his gang, including young Hartley, to hold up the stagecoach on its return trip from Missionary Flats and take the cargo of gold dust it is carrying. Sheriff Hartley is notified of the planned holdup by one of his deputies who has been spying on Collins, and organizes a posse. A deputy-sheriff is killed in the ensuing gunfight between the lawmen and the outlaws, but Deputy Joe Larkin, pursues and captures Clay Hartley Jr. The latter is quickly tried and convicted of the killing of the deputy, and sentenced to be hung. Sheriff Hartley has only a few hours to prove his son was not the killer. He enlists the aid of Collins' step-daughter, Joan, who is in love with Hartley's son.

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: Dad Longworth robs a Mexican bank, takes the loot, and leaves his partner Rio to be captured. However, Rio escapes capture and searches for Dad in California.

programme.title: All of My heart 2
programme.desc: Brian and Jenny are preparing for the big opening of their bed and breakfast, Emily's Country Inn, when a huge storm hits Bucks County. Brian agrees to return to Wall Street to boost their funds, while Jenny scrambles to keep the opening on time.

programme.title: The Perfect Stalker
programme.desc: When Grace becomes obsessed with her neighbor she invents an imaginary stalker to help get him to protect her.

programme.title: Sweetheart Con
programme.desc: Heartbroken over her parents' breakup and recovering from a car accident, Jane becomes increasingly suspicious of her mother's charming new boyfriend.

programme.title: My Daddy is in Heaven
programme.desc: Becky, Adam and their 5-year-old daughter Acie are a perfect family until a tragic accident during a 4th of July celebration kills their father. Struggling with grief, Becky decides she needs to leave the family farm and all its memories. She leaves Acie with her grandfather Ben and visits with her friend from school, June. With all the best intent, June offers Becky plenty of distraction from her family life. Fueled by her anger at G*d and loss of faith, Becky starts drinking and making other self-destructive choices. Then, after Becky is arrested, Ben threatens to keep Acie until Becky is back on track. A chance encounter in a bus station with a traveler gives Becky what she needs to...

programme.title: Undercover Angel
programme.desc: When a little girl prays for a miracle to help her recently divorced mother settle in their new town and fixer-upper house, an angel posing as a handyman, is sent down from heaven to help. While trying to accomplish his mission, the angel falls for the mother, ultimately forcing him into the unlikeliest of choices.

programme.title: The Perfect Cheerleader
programme.desc: Cassie's dream cheerleading squad takes a dark turn when a new man and a murder uncover a deadly conspiracy.

programme.title: Amber Alert
programme.desc: A woman goes on the run with her children to escape an abusive husband, who is the District Attorney. He puts out an Amber Alert for them.

programme.title: Sugar Baby Murder
programme.desc: A new executive assistant to a business tycoon learns that a life of luxury can come at a deadly price.

programme.title: Cheer for Your Life
programme.desc: A high schooler faces a brutal cheer initiation. When things turn deadly and she disappears, her mom must act.

programme.title: The Bad Son
programme.desc: An elusive serial killer is killing innocent women in Seattle. The police and FBI are on the killer's trail but were never prepared to face a bizarre twist in the case.

programme.title: Our Dream Wedding
programme.desc: Haley, staunchly anti-marriage, tries on her grandma's magical veil and sees her future with boyfriend Scott.

programme.title: Love's Second Chance
programme.desc: Stylist Rose inherits her grandmother's dress shop and reconnects with her old crush, Cole, sparking romance.

programme.title: Once Upon a Date
programme.desc: When top-notched real estate broker, Josh Donahue, is sent to buyout a community playhouse he unexpectedly falls for the owner forcing him to decide between the family business and true love.

programme.title: At Home With Tori
programme.desc: Tori teams up with Million Dollar Matchmaker Patti Stanger to host a series of dates for Morgan, one of her single friends.

programme.title: The Past Never Dies
programme.desc: CASEY MARSH was born in captivity. Her mother, JANE, was abducted as a teenager and gave birth to Casey while she was being held by the kidnapper, TIMOTHY FAST. Jane eventually escaped when Casey was 6 years old. Timothy Fast was arrested and incarcerated. Ever since, Jane has struggled to regain a normal life for her and her daughter. For Casey, the memories of a childhood in captivity still haunt her. Jane, on the other hand, has seemingly moved on. She has re-married and is happy. When a number of local women start to go missing, Jane reveals to Casey that Timothy might have had an accomplice and wonders if he is involved. The kidnapping M.O. is eerily similar. Casey is furious that...

programme.title: Sugar Baby Murder
programme.desc: A new executive assistant to a business tycoon learns that a life of luxury can come at a deadly price.

programme.title: Cheer for Your Life
programme.desc: A high schooler faces a brutal cheer initiation. When things turn deadly and she disappears, her mom must act.

programme.title: The Bad Son
programme.desc: An elusive serial killer is killing innocent women in Seattle. The police and FBI are on the killer's trail but were never prepared to face a bizarre twist in the case.

programme.title: Our Dream Wedding
programme.desc: Haley, staunchly anti-marriage, tries on her grandma's magical veil and sees her future with boyfriend Scott.

programme.title: Love's Second Chance
programme.desc: Stylist Rose inherits her grandmother's dress shop and reconnects with her old crush, Cole, sparking romance.

programme.title: Once Upon a Date
programme.desc: When top-notched real estate broker, Josh Donahue, is sent to buyout a community playhouse he unexpectedly falls for the owner forcing him to decide between the family business and true love.

programme.title: Alter
programme.desc: Alter, a psychological thriller about a man who is convinced that he’s found his childhood abductor, and is determined to get him to confess by any means necessary.

programme.title: Sweet Autumn

programme.desc: Leningrad Cowboys, en gruppe sibiriske musikere, og deres manager rejser til Amerika på jagt efter berømmelse og formue. Mens de krydser landet, bliver de fulgt af landsbyidioten, som ønsker at blive medlem af bandet.

programme.title: Bitchkram
programme.desc: Kristin tæller dagene til studentereksamen, hvor hun endelig kan forlade den lille by og sin manipulerende søster for sit drømmeland, New York. Alt er perfekt, og den lokale avis har lovet at offentliggøre Kristins klummer om byen, der aldrig sover.

programme.title: Storm
programme.desc: Freddy redder en hund fra dens ustabile ejer og gemmer den på sit værelse. Da Freddys far opdager hunden, insisterer han på at give den tilbage til ejeren. En skrækslagen Freddy overbeviser sin far om, at de skal købe hunden.

programme.title: Hamlet liikemaailmassa
programme.desc: En moderne fortolkning af Shakespeares Hamlet, sat i en forretningsverden hvor magtspil og intriger dominerer.

programme.title: Christmas Story
programme.desc: Da den unge Nikolas bliver forældreløs, bliver han adopteret af hvert hus i hans landsby i et år. Efter at han forlader huset, giver han dem en julegave og fortsætter traditionen, selv efter han er blevet voksen.

programme.title: The Fat & The Angry - Part 1
programme.desc: Anmelderrost, brutalt gangsterdrama af Johan Renck! FBI og Interpol får nys om en stor sag om kreditkortsvindel, og narkomanen Sebbe hentes ind som mistænkt. Da politiet påbegynder afhøringen, får de en utrolig historie fra Göteborgs underverden at høre.

programme.title: Som dag og nat
programme.desc: SOM DAG OG NAT er en komedie om kærlighed. Den handler om to søstre: den ene nyudnævnt borgmester i Stockholm, nyskilt og mor til to døtre.

programme.title: Liza Marklund: Røde Ulv

programme.title: The Fat & The Angry - Part 2

"Everything, Everything" fortæller historien om Maddy, en klog og fantasifuld 18-årig, der på grund af en sygdom ikke kan forlade beskyttelsen i sit hermetisk lukkede miljø, og Olly, nabodrengen, der ikke vil lade det stoppe dem.

programme.desc: De er 30-something, succesfulde, bor i Swinging London og stinker til faste forhold. Alligevel er modepigen Jacks evig ihærdig med at fixe vennerne op på nye blind dates.

programme.desc: Da Griffin får at vide, at han har en dødelig sygdom beslutter han sig for at tage livet i egne hænder og have det sjovt før han dør. Samtidig med at tiden løber ud bliver han forelsket i Phoenix - som også har en hemmelighed.

programme.title: Teen Spirit

programme.desc: Efter 28 dage i fængslet er Sin-Dee Rella tilbage på gaden. Hun er transkvinde og prostitueret og møder sin ven og kollega, Alexandra, som fortæller, at Sin-Dees kæreste og alfons har haft en affære i hendes fravær.

programme.title: Thanks for Sharing
programme.desc: Adam har netop krydset 5-års dagen for at holde drifterne under kontrol som kureret sex-afhængig, da han møder Phoebe, som han indleder en heftig flirt med. I gruppen for sex-afhængige møder frisøren Dede, nørden Neil, men det er svært at være venner med det modsatte køn.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Colombia, 1992. Den ni-årige Cataleya er vidne til mordet på sine forældre. Hun slipper med nød og næppe fra massakren og søger tilflugt i USA hos sin onkel, der er gangster. 15 år senere arbejder Cataleya (Zoe Saldana) som professionel lejemorder.

programme.title: Programmerne genoptages snart
programme.desc: Vi er ved at indhente vores skønhedssøvn! Bliv hængende for mere uvurderlig underholdning udvalgt af Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: Opdagelsesrejsende Dirk Pitt med flere tager på det allerstørste eventyr, når de leder efter et jernbeklædt kampskib med hemmelig last i Vestafrika.

programme.title: The Happytime Murders
programme.desc: "The Happytime Murders" finder sted i LAs allerdybeste afkroge, hvor dukker og mennesker lever blandt hinanden. To detektiver - et menneske og en dukke - bliver tvunget til at arbejde sammen for at finde ud af, hvem der brutalt slår de tidligere medlemmer af det engang så elskede dukkeshow ihjel!

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Den flittige highschool-pige, Vee Delmonico, har fået nok af bare at være tilskuer til livet.

programme.title: TMNT
programme.desc: Splint; rotten sensei; fornemmer, at hans fire teenagere skildpadde-disciple er vokset fra hinanden og har brug for at knytte bånd for at besejre et gammelt monster.

programme.title: Pete Smalls Is Dead
programme.desc: KC er fortvivlet, da lokale bøller stjæler hans hund og kræver at få de 10.000 dollars han skylder dem. Hans forhenværende bedste ven, Jack, fortæller at han har pengene...

programme.title: Power Rangers
programme.desc: Power Rangers følger fem helt almindelige high school-elever, som vågner op med superkræfter, efter at have fundet et ældgammelt rumskib.

programme.title: Vampire Academy
programme.desc: Lissa og Rose er to 17-årige piger, der går i gymnasiet ligesom de fleste andre 17-årige piger. Forskellen er bare, at Lissa drikker blod og, og at deres gymnasium er en hemmelig kostskole for fredelige Moroi-vampyrer og deres beskyttere!

programme.title: Joyride
programme.desc: Jon, en ulykkeligt forelsket, men charmerende fiasko på nærmest alle punkter, Luke, en superkører på flugt fra fortiden, og Keira, medarbejder i en burgerrestaurant og veganeraktivist, kommer på kant af loven på deres tur gennem New Zealand i en ”lånt” gul Mini Cooper.

programme.title: Ghost Rider - Spirit Of Vengeance
programme.desc: Johnny Blaze kæmper stadig med sin forbandelse som djævelens dusørjager. Og da han hyres til et job af en hemmelig religiøs sekt, føler han sig ikke parat til endnu en gang at påtage sig Ghost Riders flammende kræfter og magt. Men måske er dette den sidste mulighed for at gøre sig fri.

programme.title: Prey
programme.desc: Et ungt par er truet på livet af en ekstremistisk milits og må flygte fra deres mission i Kalahariørkenen. Men da deres fly styrter ned i et dyrereservat, må de kæmpe mod både mennesker og vilde dyr for at overleve.

programme.title: Crown Vic
programme.desc: Filmen følger en uforglemmelig nat i politibetjent Ray Mandels liv i Los Angeles, mens han jagter to politimordere, der er på fri fod.

programme.title: Vault
programme.desc: “Vault” foregår I 1975 og er inspireret af den sande historie om en flok småforbryderes forsøg på at begå det største kup i USA’s historie.

programme.title: Murder Company
programme.desc: Under invasionen op til D-dag får en gruppe amerikanske soldater ordre til at smugle et medlem af den franske modstandsbevægelse ind bag fjendens linjer for at snigmyrde en højt rangerende nazist. Baseret på virkelige hændelser.

programme.title: Programmerne genoptages snart
programme.desc: Vi er ved at indhente vores skønhedssøvn! Bliv hængende for mere uvurderlig underholdning udvalgt af Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Banana Joe lever lykkeligt i en tropisk landsby i Sydamerika, der endnu ikke er blevet forpestet af hårdhudede virksomheder, korruption, stoffer, bander eller andre sygdomme fra det moderne samfund.

programme.title: Hjælp, jeg ser rødt
programme.desc: Morskaben begynder i Miami, da politiaspiranten Dave Speed spillet af den hysterisk morsomme Terence Hill, sendes ud til et øde sumpområde for at aflevere en bøde.

programme.title: Aliens på loftet
programme.desc: Pearson-familien holder ferie i et dødssygt hus på landet, da små rumvæsner lander på taget med planer om at erobre huset OG hele jorden!

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Bob Ho er en international superagent, der har prøvet det meste... biljagter, eksplosioner, fald fra høje bygninger... you name it. Men intet kan måle sigmed hans næste store opgave: En weekend som babysitter for hans kærestes tre møgunger!

programme.title: Impact Earth
programme.desc: En astronomiprofessor og tidligere NASA-medarbejder gør den skrækindjagende opdagelse; at en destruktiv asteroide er på vej direkte mod Jorden. Nu må han beskytte sin familie; mens han gør verden opmærksom på den kommende ødelæggelse.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Middelalderen bliver nok aldrig den samme, efter gadesmarte Jamal Walker falder i en voldgrav i en forlystelsespark og ender med at blive sendt tilbage i tiden.

programme.title: Epic Movie
programme.desc: Historien handler om fire ikke-så-unge forældreløse børn: den første opdraget af en museumsinspektør på Louvre (hvor en albino snigmorder lurer), den anden, en flygtet fra mexicansk fribrydning, den tredje, et offer for slanger på sit fly, og den fjerne, en “normal” borger i mutant X-samfundet.

programme.title: Vi holder med flodhestene
programme.desc: Som altid er de to brødre konstant på kant, men en ting kan få dem til at finde sammen igen. Hvis der er andre, der skal have nogle øretæver og det sker tit. Denne gang er de taget til Afrika, hvor de lever af at tage skydegale turister på safari.

programme.title: Power Rangers

programme.desc: I det berygtede Klong Prem-fængsel står briten Billy Moore over for menneskets mørkeste sider. Efter flere års misbrug og et hårdt liv på gaden i Thailand er hans tidligere præstationer som ung bokser langt væk.

programme.title: Police Story 3: Supercop
programme.desc: Superstrømeren Ka-Kui fra politiet i Hongkong, der er ekspert inden for kampsport, sendes til fastlandet for at hjælpe Interpol med at infiltrere underverdenen.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: Året er 2031. Et klima-eksperiment er slået fejl og en ny istid truer menneskeracens overlevelse. Det er lykkedes nogle få at overleve ombord på et højteknologisk tog, der konstant er i bevægelse - hvis motoren stopper, dør alle ombord.

programme.title: The Shanghai Job
programme.desc: En udbrændt privatsikkerhedsagent får æren af at eskortere en værdifuld kinesisk antikvitet fra Shanghai, men støder på modstand undervejs.

programme.title: Programmerne genoptages snart

programme.title: Tyve & røvere
programme.desc: 280 Punds øretæver bliver sluppet løs på Miamis intetanende mafia!""Tyve & røvere"" foregår i Miami og handler om den hårdtprøvede betjent Parker (Bud Spencer), der bliver sendt ud for at fange den lille og uinteressante tyveknægt Roma (Tomas Milian).

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Efter næsten at have mistet livet i “Daredevil” er superheltinden ELEKTRA tilbage i en verden af drab og bedrag – stærkere, smukkere og smidigere end før, men hendes ofre når knap at opfatte, hvad der sker. Hendes mission er at dræbe, og hun er effektiv.

programme.title: Hjælp, jeg ser rødt
programme.desc: Morskaben begynder i Miami, da politiaspiranten Dave Speed spillet af den hysterisk morsomme Terence Hill, sendes ud til et øde sumpområde for at aflevere en bøde.

programme.desc: Terence Hill og Bud Spencer er tilbage i den vildeste skattejagtskomedie. I håbet om at finde en begravet skat på en øde ø, prøver Hill at stikke af med Spencers båd, men efter et slagsmål ender de begge i vandet.

programme.title: We own the night
programme.desc: Brooklyn, 1988. Kriminaliteten er udbredt, især narkotika og narkovold. En russisk bølle opbygger sin heroinhandel, mens alle griner af politiet. Brødrene har valgt forskellige veje: Joe er fulgt sin far Bert ind i New York's Finest; han er en stigende stjerne.

programme.title: Windtalkers
programme.desc: I den brutale slag ved Saipan under Anden Verdenskrig vogter sergent Joe Enders (Nicolas Cage) – og bliver venner med – Ben Yahzee (Adam Beach), en ung Navajo trænet i den eneste krigskode, som fjenden aldrig har knækket... Navajo-koden.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: I den tempofyldte, og adrenalindrevetaction thriller POINT BREAK infiltrererden unge FBI-agent Johnny Utah(Luke Bracey), en gruppe spændingssøgende ekstremsportsatleter – der erledet af den karismatiske Bodhi.

programme.title: The Mothman Prophecies
programme.desc: Efter at journalisten John Kleins hustru Mary omkommer i en bilulykke, finder han en notesblok på hendes værelse. Den er fuld af tegninger af et monster med lædervinger. En aften farer John vild og havner i Point Pleasant, West Virginia.

programme.title: Cold War
programme.desc: COLD WAR er en svimlende kærlighedshistorie om to mennesker med meget forskellig baggrund og vidt forskellige temperamenter. De er helt forkerte for hinanden, men er alligevel via passionen og musikken dømt til at blive ved med at søge hinanden.

programme.title: I Love You Phillip Morris
programme.desc: Da Steve Russell (Jim Carrey) flytter til Miami for at starte et nyt liv som bøsse, koster det et gigantisak overtræk på kassekreditten og en tur i spjældet. Her møder han den følsomme Phillip Morris (Ewan McGregor) og forelsker sig fra sans og samling.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Bob Ho er en international superagent, der har prøvet det meste... biljagter, eksplosioner, fald fra høje bygninger... you name it. Men intet kan måle sigmed hans næste store opgave: En weekend som babysitter for hans kærestes tre møgunger!

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Baseret på den sande historie om fire outsidere, der så, hvad de store banker, medierne og regeringen ikke kunne: Den globale økonomis kollaps. En modig investering leder dem in i den mørke underverden i bankverdenen, hvor alt og alle er tvivlsomme.

programme.title: Warm Bodies
programme.desc: Kærlighed overvinder alt ... selv den uimodståelige trang til at spise din kærestes hjernemasse! I en ikke så fjern fremtid er jorden befolket af lige dele menneskeædende zombier og zombiebekæmpende mennesker.

programme.title: A Walk to Remember
programme.desc: Da den oprørske Landon spiller overfor bogormen Jamie i skolens teaterstykke, blomstrer romantikken – lige indtil en tragedie truer med at flå dem fra hinanden.

programme.title: What if
programme.desc: Den håbløse romantiker Wallace (Daniel Radcliffe) er droppet ud fra medicinstudiet og har brændt fingrene på kærligheden. Da han møder Chantry (Zoe Kazan) til en fest, er der kemi med det samme. Wallace falder for Chantry, men der er bare ét problem: hun har en kæreste.

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Da en hårdtarbejdende redaktør på The New Yorker (Helen Hunt) følger efter sin søn (Brenton Thwaites) til L.A., efter han er droppet ud af college for at finde sig selv, ender hun med selv at være den, der kastes ud i en fuldstændig forvandling.

programme.title: To Rome With Love
programme.desc: Efter succesen Midnight In Paris kommer To Rome With Love - en hyldest til Rom, en af verdens mest fortryllende byer.Dette er historien om dem, der bor i denne by, dem som er på besøg og om romantikken og eventyrene, de oplever.

programme.title: Death At A Funeral
programme.desc: For de fleste er begravelser bare noget, der skal overstås, og hvis det stod til Daniel, så sprang han gerne denne dag over, hvor hans far skal stedes til hvile.

programme.title: The Hunting Party
programme.desc: Journalister drager til krigsplaget Bosnien for at fange en krigsforbryder, men de forveksles med CIA-agenter og bliver målet for dødsensfarlige fjender.

programme.title: Lucky Number Slevin
programme.desc: Slevin (Josh Harnett) er knap nok rykket ind i vennen Nicks lejlighed før to gangsterbosser ønsker at ”tale” med ham. Eller: de ønsker at tale med Nick, og Slevin har svært ved at overbevise dem om at han ikke er Nick, da hans id er blevet stjålet.

programme.title: Love The Coopers
programme.desc: Da fire generationer af Cooper-klanen samles til en genforening, kommer en række uventede gæster og usandsynlige begivenheder til at vende op og ned på deres aften.

programme.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
programme.desc: Velkommen til en katolsk pigeskole i hjertet af Chicago, byen som er hjem for USA's mest populære danseshow: Dance TV! Udvekslingsstudenten Janey Glenn er et nervevrag, da hun bliver præsenteret for sine fnisende klassekammerater af den strenge søster Katherine.

programme.title: Som dag og nat
programme.desc: SOM DAG OG NAT er en komedie om kærlighed. Den handler om to søstre: den ene nyudnævnt borgmester i Stockholm, nyskilt og mor til to døtre.

programme.title: Officer og spion
programme.desc: I 1895 anklages kaptajn Alfred Dreyfus (Louis Garrel), en ung og lovende officer, for spionage til tyskerne og dømmes til livsvarigt fængsel på Djævleøen. Dreyfus' ydmygelse følges også af Georges Picquart (Jean Dujardin), der er blevet forfremmet til at lede kontraespionagenheden.

programme.title: Gensyn med Yorkshire
programme.desc: Arthur Morrison finder ud af, at han har kræft og kun har nogle få uger tilbage at leve i. Hans voksne søn, Blake, rejser til Yorkshire for at bo hos sin mor i den by, han voksede op i. Efterhånden som Arthurs tilstand forværres, ser Blake tilbage på sit forhold til faren.

programme.title: This is England
programme.desc: England, sommeren 1983. Margaret Thatcher styrer nationen med jerngreb, og nationalistiske strømninger får fodfæste i en arbejderklasse uden arbejde. Den tolvårige Shaun går alene gennem skoleferien, men lærer Woody, som leder en bande af skinheads, at kende.

programme.title: 10 Items or Less
programme.desc: Morgan Freeman ( Seven, Red, Batman Begins) kendt men aldrende skuespiller møder på sin research til en ny rolle en smuk spansk kassedame, der er mere end træt af sit job, som består i at servicere de kunder som har 10 eller færre varer.

programme.title: To Rome With Love
programme.desc: Efter succesen Midnight In Paris kommer To Rome With Love - en hyldest til Rom, en af verdens mest fortryllende byer.Dette er historien om dem, der bor i denne by, dem som er på besøg og om romantikken og eventyrene, de oplever.

programme.title: Laws of Attraction
programme.desc: Dygtige skilsmisseadvokater; Audrey Woods og Daniel Rafferty; har set kærligheden gå galt i alle dens værste tilfælde - så hvor dårlige kan deres chancer være?

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: De startede som et undergrundswebsite og blev verdens mest eftersøgte personer.

programme.title: Child's Play (2019)
programme.desc: Fra producenterne bag ”IT” kommer CHILD’S Play, en helt ny version af den klassiske gyserhistorie om den onde dukke Chucky, nu med Mark Hamill som stemmen bag.

programme.title: The Mothman Prophecies

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Ægteparret Simon (Jason Bateman) og Robyn (Rebecca Hall) lever tilsyneladende det perfekte liv. Men da de ved et tilfælde støder ind i Simons gamle skolekammerat, Gordo (Joel Edgerton), begynder facaden langsomt at krakelere.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Ray Keene (John Cusack), en far, der ønsker at gøre oprør i sin søns (Jamie Andersons) øjne, forsøger at bringe Carden (Morgan Freeman), en snigmorder i verdensklasse, for retten. Hele tiden skal han beskytte sin søn og undgå snigmorderholdet, der metodisk jagter dem i vildmarken.

programme.title: Programmerne genoptages snart
programme.desc: Vi er ved at indhente vores skønhedssøvn! Bliv hængende for mere uvurderlig underholdning udvalgt af Rakuten TV.

programme.title: While We're Young
programme.desc: New Yorker-parret Josh og Cornelia er begge i 40’erne. Det med at stifte familie er ikke lykkedes og de har besluttet sig for at være tilfredse med tilværelsen alligevel. Men alderskrisen kradser.

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Da en hårdtarbejdende redaktør på The New Yorker (Helen Hunt) følger efter sin søn (Brenton Thwaites) til L.A., efter han er droppet ud af college for at finde sig selv, ender hun med selv at være den, der kastes ud i en fuldstændig forvandling.

programme.desc: Dette er fortællingen om Ellen og hendes venner, og deres mere eller mindre selvforskyldt komplicerede kærlighedsliv og romantiske drømme.

programme.title: Cypher
programme.desc: I et skyggefuldt område af virksomhedsspionage snubler en kedet allemand ind i et net af bedrag og bliver en uvidende spion. Mens han navigerer i forræderi og forræderi, samarbejder han med en forførende gåde for at afsløre chokerende sandheder og genvinde sin identitet.

programme.title: Miraklet i Le Havre
programme.desc: I den finske film 'Miraklet i Le Havre' har den tidligere forfatter og nuværende boheme Marcel Marx slået sig ned i den nordfranske havneby Le Havre. Her lever han et stille liv mellem bistroen, arbejdet og kæresten Arletty. En dag lander den afrikanske dreng Idrissa på hans dørtrin.

programme.title: Before Midnight
programme.desc: I "Before Midnight" møder vi parret Jesse og Celina næsten to årtier efter deres første møde på et tog mod Wien. Årene er gået, og nu bor de sammen i Paris.

programme.title: Håbet er lysegrønt
programme.desc: Efter 30 års ægteskab deltager et midaldrende ægtepar i en intens, ugelang terapisession for at arbejde på deres forhold.

programme.title: The Dreamers
programme.desc: Tre kineaster – den amerikanske udvekslingsstudent Matthew og tvillingeparret Théo og Isabelle – er blevet venner via deres fælles interesse. Matthew er fascineret af Théo og Isabelles uortodokse intime bånd.

programme.title: Liza Marklund: En Plads I Solen
programme.desc: Mørket har sænket sig over Costa del Sol, da en svensk børnefamilie findes gasset ihjel i deres spanske hjem. Annika Bengtzon bliver sendt til Marbella for at dække sagen, men hun kæmper samtidig sin egen kamp.

programme.title: Mary Shelley
programme.desc: Mary Shelley fortæller historien om Mary Wollstonecraft Godwin – forfatter af “Frankenstein”, en af verdens mest berømte gotiske romancer – og hendes lidenskabelige og stormfulde forhold til den berømte romantiske poet Percy Bysshe Shelley.
